title: CR-005 Silk on Plaster
description: Source-backed V3.4 artifact transformation: translate the verified CR-002 Song Corridor Editorial photograph into a contemporary mineral-pigment architectural mural on prepared plaster. Uses portrait_to_architectural_mural + mineral_pigment_mural + wall_surface + newly_created. Symbolic reference roles only; binary reference packaging is out of PromptRecipe scope. Operator must supply the verified CR-002 PNG (SHA-256 a457c47cd96633b18d69e218f3316edb9886ea58114b96f2b4c0d1dce18221e0) as the image input at generation time. See docs/CR_005_SILK_ON_PLASTER.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Transform the referenced adult fashion photograph into a contemporary commissioned mineral-pigment mural painted on a prepared plaster architectural wall inside a quiet cultural gallery. Preserve recognizable visual identity of the source adult figure, the distinguishing stance and silhouette, the restrained upswept hairstyle structure, and the layered open-front garment arrangement with major fold architecture, but translate photographic skin, hair, and silk into matte mineral-pigment fields bound to the plaster plane. The result must read as a wall-integrated mural installation—not a living model standing in front of a mural, not a framed canvas or pasted poster, not a floating image panel, and not an excavated Song-dynasty or Dunhuang cave reconstruction. Keep physically plausible plaster texture, planar perspective, surrounding architecture that establishes installation scale, and coherent gallery lighting.
